svg.title: NBO layer outputs and composite ranking for a sample customer
svg.desc: A worked example showing what each NBO layer outputs for a single customer and how they combine into a ranked next-best-offer list. The diagram has four per-layer columns at top showing per-product scores (propensity, sequence transition probability, timing probability, expected value), a composite formula showing the multiplication, four calculation rows showing the math for each candidate product, and a final ranked output table sorted by composite score.

g.text: Customer 12345 · Checking + Savings holder · Active in last 30 days
High propensity capped by low value
